visual_observations.description: Barren plains with scattered rocks under overcast skies and strong winds. Sparse vegetation observed, offering little nutritional value. No immediate water sources visible. Wildlife is scarce, though occasional insects are present. Danger level is high due to exposure to elements and lack of resources.
Improvised shelter created using scattered rocks for minimal cover against wind and cold.
Presence of insects suggesting potential underground moisture, despite no visible water sources.
